mentions.name: Chrome tab manager extension with duplicate tab killing
mentions.description: A Chrome browser extension that manages open tabs and kills duplicated tabs, built as a one-shot test after the tab manager the author previously used stopped being maintained.
mentions.problem: The tab manager extension the author relied on died because it only supported Manifest V2 and was never updated.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tab manager extension for Chrome, that also kills duplicated tabs.
